mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right paint finish for my interior trim?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right paint finish for interior trim involves considering durability, cleanability, and aesthetic preference. Semi-gloss and gloss finishes are popular choices for trim due to their high durability, easy cleaning, and ability to highlight architectural details. They also reflect light, making the trim stand out. Satin finishes offer a slightly less reflective look while still providing good durability. For high-traffic areas or homes with children and pets, a semi-gloss is often recommended. We can provide samples and discuss the pros and cons of each finish based on your specific needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Select a trim paint finish based on durability, cleanability, and desired aesthetic; semi-gloss or gloss are popular for durability and highlighting details, while satin offers a softer look.
